title: Choking: abdominal thrusts
summary: For a choking adult: stand behind, fist above the navel, quick upward thrusts.

key_points: For a choking adult: stand behind, fist above the navel, quick upward thrusts

sections.heading: Key points
sections.body: Choking: abdominal thrusts. For a choking adult: stand behind, fist above the navel, quick upward thrusts.

sections.heading: Procedure
sections.body: Ask: confirm they cannot cough, speak, or breathe. Position: stand behind and wrap your arms around the waist. Thrust: make a fist above the navel and pull sharply inward and upward. Repeat until the object clears or they become unresponsive — then call emergency services and begin CPR.
